label: Post-result ambient-load and raw CT negative-control diagnostic; not preregistration and not confirmatory validation
questions: Does DecontX-estimated CT contamination change from Pre to Post differently between remission groups at the patient unit?
Do raw CT-pseudobulk immune and stromal negative-control transcripts show the same remission-associated change pattern as Candidate6?

fixed_inputs.sample_matrices: same 82 sparse cell-by-gene NPZ files extracted from the audited GSE282122 H5AD

eligibility: same raw labeled-state threshold: at least 20 CT cells at both visits of a site pair
unit: site Post-minus-Pre followed by equal-site patient mean

rationale.PTPRC: immune-lineage transcript not expected as a CT-colonocyte defining signal
rationale.COL1A1: stromal-fibroblast transcript not expected as a CT-colonocyte defining signal

negative_controls.raw_score: per gene log2((raw CT-pseudobulk count +0.5)/(raw CT all-gene UMI+1)*1e6)
negative_controls.composite: unweighted mean of the two negative-control logCPM values
negative_controls.positive_extraction_check: recompute the frozen six-gene CT score and require exact numerical agreement with Stage003 within tolerance 1e-10

contamination_diagnostics.primary_unit_for_interpretation: patient-level Post-minus-Pre contrast using the same eligible site pairs
contamination_diagnostics.sample_state_cross_sectional: reproduce as descriptive only because observations repeat within patients
contamination_diagnostics.statistics: OLS 95CI, HC3 P and exact patient-label permutation for patient-level changes; Wilcoxon rank-sum for the descriptive sample-state snapshot

interpretation_rules: No clear negative-control or patient-level contamination-change contrast weighs against a broad immune/stromal ambient-load explanation aligned with remission.
Such null diagnostics do not prove absence of gene-specific ambient RNA, misclassification or model-dependent effects.
A negative-control change aligned with Candidate6 or a clear patient-level contamination-change contrast strengthens the ambient-confounding concern.

DecontX using released state labels has asymmetric ability to remove cluster-typical versus cluster-atypical genes; CT survival is described as not overturned by this specific sensitivity, not as stronger after correction.
TA or LGR5 attenuation is insufficient to classify their raw signal as ambient RNA; it only removes support for the broad cross-lineage claim under the fixed family.
no_tuning: no additional negative-control genes after results
no claim that null controls make an ambient artifact impossible
